rationale: Both parties agree that the no-AA-API branch passes no contract to `convertIndexerConfig`, and the crux is whether this PR introduced that Subquery failure; the pre-PR hunk already entered its indexer-only branch only when `smartAccountContract` was absent and passed that absent value, while `packages/account-management/src/accounts/strategies/indexerConfigUtils.ts:53-58` requires a contract code ID for Subquery. The limitation is therefore pre-existing rather than a regression in this PR, so the finding is dismissed.
title: Preserve Subquery configuration on the indexer-only path
